name: Cron Expression Explainer
summary: Translate a 5-field cron expression into plain English and see the next UTC runs.
description: Paste a standard cron expression (minute hour day-of-month month day-of-week) to get a human summary, per-field meanings, and the next few UTC fire times. Supports lists, ranges, steps, and month/weekday aliases.

faqs.question: Which cron format is supported?
faqs.answer: Standard 5-field cron: minute, hour, day-of-month, month, day-of-week. Six-field (with seconds) is not supported yet.

faqs.question: Are next runs in my local timezone?
faqs.answer: Next runs are shown in UTC for consistency. Convert with the Unix Timestamp tool if you need local time.

faqs.question: How do day-of-month and day-of-week interact?
faqs.answer: When both are restricted, a match on either field is enough (standard cron OR semantics).
